review_method: Direct view_image inspection of individual actual Godot screenshots. No contact sheet, image edits, map edits or core edits.

checks.name: M31-object-court

运输车名称、耐久28/28、血条和车锁操作说明全部位于信息框内部；北口方向提示在屏幕左上保持完整。
checks.text_safe_area: No visible clipping, border collision or overlap between the inspected text rows.
checks.limitation: 本张证明第6回合车体/道路/界面呈现，不单独证明后续停车时机或全部车道路径。

resolved_capture_issue.original: M32-object-cart_release captured the already completed battle and was obscured by its victory panel.
resolved_capture_issue.resolution: Replaced by ordinary-input turn-6 checkpoint focused on the real transport-cart position; inspected M32-turn-6 instead. The current gallery remains 24 images.

limits: This review covers selected static mid-battle and settlement views, not every camera position, target tooltip or menu state.
Combat animation, movement animation and idle performance were outside scope.
Walkability, AI timing, evacuation outcomes and story branching rely on the independent gameplay and rule checks; a screenshot alone does not prove them.
Pixel hashes are used so later lossless PNG compression does not invalidate the inspected pixels.
